items.text: honestly i do like the game, i am going to give it a positive cause this is a type of game im really into, i dont write reviews like at all lol, but i did read the reviews before i bought the game and thought to myself that it cant be that bad. BEHOLD, a fire randomly starts in my ship, i just started the game so i have no idea what the cause of my fires are, i still have the beginner ship, and i dont have tons of materials to repair every corner of my ship, the fire blows a hole in my ship, i cant repair it, i die, i load, i put out the fire, i play for ~ 20 minutes im in space, another fire starts, i put it out but i had no idea you could flush your air, so i die from the smoke, i load again, i make it to a station, my ship catches on fire, my walls and components burn, i load again cause i die lol, its a never ending cycle, so im just going to either start over or load a waaaaaaaaaaaaay earlier save, cause i cant play like this where i keep dying every 20-40 minutes, i kinda soft locked myself into my position so its my own fault, it definitely has potential, though it is kinda annoying, and i hired a crewmate and theres a death fee, which is basically life insurance, its 50k, and i only had 20k, and theres interest, so i was paying 9k every "shift" to this woman cause i couldn't afford it lol, live and learn
items.text_zh: 老实说，我确实喜欢这个游戏，我打算给它一个好评，因为这是我真正喜欢的那种游戏，我平时根本不写评测，哈哈，但我在买游戏之前确实读了评测，心里想着应该不会那么糟。结果呢，我的飞船里随机起火了，我才刚开始玩，所以完全不知道起火的原因是什么，我还开着新手船，也没有大量材料来修理飞船的每个角落，火烧穿了我的飞船，我修不了，我死了，我读档，我把火扑灭，我在太空里玩了大约20分钟，又起火了，我把它扑灭了，但我不知道你可以排空空气，所以我被烟熏死了，我又读档，我到达了一个空间站，我的飞船着火了，我的墙壁和部件都烧起来了，我又读档，因为我又死了，哈哈，这是个永无止境的循环，所以我要么重新开始，要么读一个非常非常非常早的存档，因为我没法这样玩下去，每20到40分钟就死一次，我有点把自己卡在这个处境里了，所以是我自己的错，它绝对有潜力，虽然有点烦人，而且我雇了一个船员，还有死亡费用，基本上就是人寿保险，要5万，而我只有2万，还有利息，所以我每个“班次”都要付给这个女人9千，因为我付不起，哈哈，吃一堑长一智

observations.description: 新手船起火后没有足够材料修复各处损坏
observations.evidence: i dont have tons of materials to repair every corner of my ship
observations.evidence_zh: 我没有大量材料来修理飞船的每个角落
